predicate.label: political body has a leader
predicate.definition: Country, political body or legislature X has or had person Y as a political leader.
includes: named parliamentary majority/minority leader or whip
excludes: party control instead of an individual leader
ambiguous: unspecified minister without evidence of head-of-government or leadership scope
predicate.notes: Harmonizes the later minister-inclusive samples to the original full-census scope. An unspecified minister alone is A, not automatically S.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: national president/ruler/head of government; named parliamentary majority/minority leader or whip; historical leadership. Excludes: corporate/team leadership; ordinary membership/meeting; party control instead of an individual leader; person-to-body forward direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unspecified minister without evidence of head-of-government or leadership scope; truncated body or unnamed officeholder. Harmonizes the later minister-inclusive samples to the original full-census scope. An unspecified minister alone is A, not automatically S.

rationale: Inverse government/minister descriptions (six paths) narrowly exceed five forward managerial titles, so body-to-political leader is primary; direction and minister-designate nonactuality are retained.
